description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Tram-on-Time Carriage House”, a stylish and private retreat tucked in the heart of Seacrest Beach. Perfect for a solo traveler or couple, this 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom guest house comfortably sleeps 2 and includes everything you need for a relaxing stay, plus two bikes to explore the scenic 30A coastline. Whether you're sipping morning coffee on the balcony, enjoying al fresco dining on your private patio or catching the sunset after a day by the beach, this cozy carriage house is your perfect beachside escape. Ready to unwind? Learn more below… 👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***1 Bedroom + 2 Bathrooms – Comfortably sleeps 2Private Carriage House – Fully separate from the main house for maximum privacyOutdoor Patio – Cozy alfresco dining area with seating for 22 Bikes Included – Cruise to the beach, pool and surrounding communitiesBalcony Access – Enjoy fresh air and sunshine with second-floor seatingPrime Seacrest Location – Steps to Lagoon Pool and tram stop to private beach access*** LIVING AREAS ***Spread across two levels, the carriage house offers multiple cozy living spaces with thoughtful touches. Whether you're relaxing with a book, watching TV or enjoying a beach day recap, this space is designed for ease and comfort.1st Floor: Cozy living area with a sectional sofa and flat-screen TV + dining area for 2 and a mini fridge for snacks and drinks2nd Floor: Main living area with flat-screen TV and balcony access*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Located on the second floor, the fully equipped kitchen offers everything you need to whip up beach snacks or full meals.Full-size stainless steel appliances including fridge, oven, microwave and dishwasherBar seating for 2 at the kitchen islandEasy access to balcony seating for open-air dining or sunset drinks*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Designed with relaxation in mind, the bedroom and bathrooms offer modern comfort and function.1st Floor:Guest bathroom with single vanity and walk-in shower2nd Floor:Primary Queen Suite – Queen bed, flat-screen TV and en-suite bathroom with single vanity and shower/tub combo*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***A private outdoor escape awaits with a small furnished patio and second-floor balcony.Outdoor patio with dining table for 2, perfect for morning coffee or evening wine2nd floor balcony with additional seating and Gulf breezes2 bikes included – ideal for cruising to Seacrest shops, restaurants or the beach*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Discover Seacrest Beach along 30A, famous for its stunning white-sand coastline, vibrant community, and nearby boutique shops and gourmet restaurants.12,000 sq. ft. Lagoon Pool with Waterfall Features (Just a 2-Minute Walk) – Escape to a luxurious oasis with a sparkling lagoon pool. Featuring a zero-entry splash zone for kids and relaxing cabanas for adults, it’s the perfect spot to soak up the sun or unwind in the shadeDining and Shops at Seacrest (2-min walk) – Enjoy a vibrant village atmosphere with charming boutiques and delightful eateries just steps away.Private Beach Access (6-minute walk or seasonal tram ride) – Enjoy effortless access to your own piece of paradise. With a tram stop conveniently located right outside your door, the pristine white sands and soothing ocean breeze are just moments away!Alys Beach (7-min walk) – Discover the unique blend of elegance and coastal charm with upscale dining options and artisan shops.Rosemary Beach (11-min walk) – Immerse yourself in the sophisticated yet laid-back vibe of Rosemary Beach, with its cobblestone streets and inviting local gems.*** PET FRIENDLY *** Non-shedding, housebroken dogs only Pets are not allowed on furniture or beds Must be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dog Non-refundable pet fee $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyPlease note that there are separate entrances for the 1st & 2nd floors. There is not an internal staircase.We do NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 2 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs (Low-Speed Vehicles) are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest or Alys Beach*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to making your vacation as effortless as it is unforgettable. From sparkling clean homes to 24/7 guest support, we take care of the details so you can focus on coastal fun, family time, and lifelong memories.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 87186STRO #: STR-087186
